tasks.title: fraction plate
tasks.prompt: Make a rectangular plate 2 inches along X, 1 inch along Y, and 1/8 inch thick, with its minimum corner at the origin, thickness along +Z. Use those exact dimensions.

tasks.title: mixed fraction
tasks.prompt: Make a rectangular plate 1 1/2 inches along X, 3/4 inch along Y, and 1/4 inch thick, with its minimum corner at the origin, thickness along +Z. Use those exact dimensions.

tasks.title: small fraction
tasks.prompt: Make a rectangular plate 5/8 inch along X, 1/2 inch along Y, and 1/16 inch thick, with its minimum corner at the origin, thickness along +Z. Use those exact dimensions.

tasks.title: missing hole size
tasks.prompt: Put a through hole at the centre of the top face. Ask one question if a required dimension is missing before changing the design.
tasks.reference_reply: What diameter should the hole be?

tasks.title: missing fillet radius
tasks.prompt: Round the four vertical corners. Ask one question if a required dimension is missing before changing the design.
tasks.reference_reply: What fillet radius should I use?
